summary: If test messages to an HTTP(S) aggregator do not arrive, check /var/log/tower/rsyslog.err (present only when errors occur). The API 4XX format can include the error message, and LDAP and SAML adapter logging can be enabled.
questions: Logging test message not received by aggregator
